channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
item.description: Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks all had vulnerabilities in edge devices come under fire this week. Now BeyondTrust joins the group.

item.title: Qilin and INC Ransomware Groups Exploit Palo Alto Networks Flaw to Bypass MFA
item.description: Palo Alto Networks has disclosed that it's continuing to observe exploitation of a now-patched security flaw impacting PAN-OS and Prisma Access by ransomware actors. The activity relates to CVE-2026-0257 (CVSS score: 7.8), an authentication bypass flaw that could be exploited by bad actors to set up unauthorized VPN…

item.title: ClickFix Attackers Exploit Siemens Software Center Flaw to Deploy Remote Access Trojan
item.description: Siemens has addressed a DLL sideloading vulnerability impacting Siemens Software Center that it said has been exploited in ClickFix attacks. The high-severity vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-110936 (CVSS v4 score: 8.4), could allow an attacker to place a specially-crafted DLL in a directory the application…

item.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to backdoor WordPress sites
item.description: A threat actor breached TeamUpdraft's website, a developer of popular WordPress backup and security plugins, potentially compromising UpdraftCentral connection keys that can send commands to connected websites.

item.title: FBI says SafePay ransomware gang ‘among most active’ with more than 600 victims since 2024
item.description: The FBI and cyber agencies in the UK and Germany said SafePay is targeting businesses and critical infrastructure by guessing passwords, exploiting vulnerabilities and using phishing attacks.

item.title: ConnectWise Resets Credentials as Cloud Backup Remains Offline After Security Incident
item.description: ConnectWise on Monday said it has taken remediation measures, including strengthening administrative-access protections and resetting accounts and replacing application credentials, as it continues to respond to a security incident that led to unauthorized access to application identities associated with Cloud Backup…

item.title: Hackers breach Microsoft 365 tenants via ConnectWise supply-chain attack
item.description: ConnectWise has shut down customer access to its Cloud Backup service (formerly SkyKick Cloud Backup) after hackers accessed application identities and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants.

item.title: Hackers Use Autonomous AI Agents to Breach Company Websites, Target Over 1,200 Sites
item.description: A Chinese-speaking criminal pointed autonomous AI agents at company websites and let them break in with almost no help, and a security researcher watched it happen because the operators left their control panels open on the internet. The agents tried more than 1,200 sites and reached websites belonging to more than…

item.title: CVE-2026-102204 Windows Subsystem for Linux Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description: Updated CVE to relect that this vulnerability is in the Windows Subsystem for Linux product. Microsoft recommends that customer using this product should install the latest version to be protected.

item.title: CVE-2026-62913 Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Updated an acknowledgement. This is an informational change only.

item.description: Updated an acknowledgement. This is an informational change only.

item.title: CVE-2026-83782 Windows Shell Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Updated an acknowledgement. This is an informational change only.

item.title: Microsoft Targets Rogue AI Agents With Dynamic Permissions, Risk Scoring
item.description: Microsoft says companies should treat AI agents as insiders, and is adding controls that grant access per task and tighten it as an agent’s risk rises. The post Microsoft Targets Rogue AI Agents With Dynamic Permissions, Risk Scoring appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: [NEU] [hoch] Microsoft Edge: Mehrere Schwachstellen ermöglichen Codeausführung
item.description: Ein entfernter, anonymer Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen in Microsoft Edge ausnutzen, um beliebigen Programmcode auszuführen.

item.title: CVE-2026-80092 Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description: Updated the Security Updates table to list Microsoft Identity Web v3 and v4 separately and clarify the affected version ranges. The existing security updates are versions 3.16.0 and 4.16.1, respectively. This is an informational change only.

item.title: PEERSTITCH Malware Deployed via FortiOS Flaw Bypasses Checks on Tagged VPN Sessions
item.description: A suspected advanced threat actor has been observed exploiting a security flaw in Fortinet FortiOS to deliver a previously unreported memory-resident ARM64 malware known as PEERSTITCH. The attack involves the exploitation of CVE-2025-61624 (CVSS score: 5.4), a path traversal flaw in the command line interpreter of…

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Authenticated RCE Flaw Amid Active Exploitation
item.description: Palo Alto Networks on Wednesday issued security updates for a high-severity flaw in PAN-OS software that has come under active exploitation. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-0322 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of remote code execution in the management interface. "A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the…

item.title: AhsayCBS Flaws Exploited to Deploy Web Shells Get New Fixes After Incomplete Patches
item.description: Singapore-based Ahsay Backup has released security updates to address two security flaws in AhsayCBS that have been exploited by bad actors to drop web shells and XMRig cryptocurrency miners. The vulnerabilities in question are CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134, which could be chained to sidestep authentication and…

item.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
item.description: CVE-2026-104935, a high-severity authentication bypass + RCE vulnerability, was only partially discovered and patched in July, leaving an opening for threat actors to capitalize on.

item.title: PHP warns admins of two critical flaws, emergency patches coming tomorrow
item.description: The PHP security team is warning administrators to prepare for emergency security updates tomorrow to address two critical vulnerabilities, as information about the flaws has reportedly leaked ahead of their scheduled disclosure.

item.title: Zeabur shutting down after second security breach in two months
item.description: Development platform Zeabur has disclosed details of a cybersecurity incident in which an attacker used leaked internal credentials stored in plaintext to compromise its infrastructure and steal over 3.2 million environment variable records and information for 321,810 accounts.

item.title: California warns all public school students of data stolen in contractor breach
item.description: The CDE released multiple statements over the last week warning the state’s students that assessment contractor Educational Testing Service (ETS) suffered a months-long data breach.

item.title: 23andMe successor settles with California for $6 million over cybersecurity failings
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced a settlement under which 23andMe's successor will pay $6 million to resolve allegations that the company did not properly protect customers' data before a 2023 breach.

item.title: Critical FortiSIEM Flaw Gets Public Exploit PoC for Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have released a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for a recently patched critical security flaw impacting Fortinet FortiSIEM that could result in arbitrary code execution. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-106173 (CVSS score: 9.4), is a critical path traversal flaw that could allow an…

item.title: Close Identity Gaps in Software Development Before Unleashing AI
item.description: Artificial Intelligence is complicating security in the software development lifecycle, but a Dark Reading roundtable found collaboration, better identity visibility, and reduced testing costs offer CISOs a way ahead.

item.title: AOMEI Backupper Compromised in Short-Burst Supply Chain Campaign
item.description: Across multiple short compromise windows, users were served a downloader for the ShinyRoad modular backdoor framework. The post AOMEI Backupper Compromised in Short-Burst Supply Chain Campaign appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Windows Server 2025 gets support for quick machine recovery
item.description: Microsoft announced that IT administrators can now use quick machine recovery on Windows Server 2025 after installing the October 2026 security update.

item.title: [NEU] [hoch] Snipe-IT: Mehrere Schwachstellen
item.description: Ein Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen in Snipe-IT ausnutzen, um beliebigen Code auszuführen, erweiterte Berechtigungen zu erlangen, SQL-Injection durchzuführen, Cross-Site-Scripting-Angriffe zu starten, Sicherheitsmaßnahmen zu umgehen, Daten zu manipulieren oder offenzulegen, einen Denial-of-Service-Zustand…

item.title: Russian APT28 Breaches NATO Naval Shipbuilder in NATO Country, Deploys New Reflective Loader
item.description: The Russia-linked state-sponsored threat actor tracked as APT28 (aka BlueDelta, Fancy Bear, and Forest Blizzard) has been attributed to attacks targeting two member states of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO). The Symantec Threat Hunter Team, which is tracking the activity cluster under the moniker…

item.title: Police arrest Qilin ransomware suspect on holiday, as links made to Synnovis hack that contributed to patient’s death
item.description: A 28-year-old Russian man has been arrested by German police, suspected of being a key member of the Qilin ransomware gang. Detectives have linked the man to the attack against blood-testing firm Synnovis, that disrupted London hospitals, and resulted in the death of a patient. Read more in my article on the Hot for…

item.title: 970,000 Medi-Cal Members Affected by Paradigm Healthcare Data Breach
item.description: Paradigm Healthcare Services detected an intrusion in October 2025, but it took nearly a year to start notifying affected individuals. The post 970,000 Medi-Cal Members Affected by Paradigm Healthcare Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Researchers Infiltrate Microsoft Tech Support Scam Operation
item.description: A large-scale scam operation impersonating Microsoft uses a malicious traffic distribution system (TDS) run by a Russian organization and abuses thousands of Cloudflare links.

item.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
item.description: Researchers say attackers authenticated into Microsoft 365 tenants using ConnectWise credentials; ConnectWise says customer impact remains unconfirmed.

item.title: OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
item.description: The open-source AI coding project OpenCode has notified a small number of users that API keys they used with external providers were exposed in a security breach.

item.title: Microsoft fixes classic Outlook bug that hid Copilot buttons
item.description: Microsoft has fixed a known issue that removed the Copilot Chat and Copilot buttons in the classic Outlook desktop mail client for some Windows users.

item.title: Fake Web3 Accelerator Uses npm Packages to Spread Malware and Hijack AI Agent Traffic
item.description: A fake Web3 accelerator has been observed pushing information stealers and backdoors to Windows and macOS systems using malicious npm packages under the pretext of offering free artificial intelligence (AI) credits for Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, coding tools, and security audits. "The tools delivered…

item.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
item.description: An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said. Console is OpenCode's optional hosted service: a workspace saves its own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google key there, and Console uses…

item.title: When Your Ransomware Negotiator Works for the Other Side
item.description: The shocking arrest of a well-known ransomware negotiator reveals the critical need for vendor program oversight.

item.title: Mozilla, Google, Apple block compromised eMudhra CA certificates
item.description: Certificate authority eMudhra revoked eight compromised intermediate certificates after researchers found their private keys were so weak that anyone could recover them almost instantly and use them to forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites.

item.title: US Agencies Detail Incident Response Practices for Rogue AI Agents
item.description: NIST, CISA and NSA share ten voluntary practices for preparing for, detecting, responding to, recovering from, and reporting rogue AI agent incidents. The post US Agencies Detail Incident Response Practices for Rogue AI Agents appeared first on SecurityWeek.
